knowledge_point.title: Using the Double-Angle Formula to Simplify Expressions

question.:question/problem: Express $\cos^2\left(168^\circ\right)-\sin^2\left(168^\circ\right)$ as a single trigonometric ratio.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Use the cosine double-angle formula:

$$
\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute $x=168^\circ$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\cos^2\left(168^\circ\right)-\sin^2\left(168^\circ\right)&=\cos\left(2\cdot 168^\circ\right)\\&=\cos\left(336^\circ\right)
\end{aligned}
$$
